files.README.md:
# Kestrelworks Fabrication - press line controller

The press line controller reads its settings from `config/pressline.json` when the line starts. The `required_settings` list names the parameters the controller has to have before it will run, and `configured` holds the values the plant engineer has entered so far.
files.docs/shift-handover.md:
# Shift handover notes

The die change on the second press runs on the maintenance team's schedule, not the controller's. Coolant top-ups and guard checks are logged on paper and stay out of the controller settings.
